development.status: to be constructed and frozen before development calls

validation.status: to be constructed and frozen after candidate freeze and before validation calls

case_oracle_schema.oracle_note: contract oracle from scenario construction, not real-world ground truth

freeze: deterministic policy rule table and precedence
learned-policy feature map, preprocessing, algorithm family, seed, and hyperparameters
local-instruction model identifier, endpoint, quantization, prompt, option order, and parser
evidence-gate contract and caller-side fallback rules

metrics.reporting_rule: Never combine gate quality and policy quality into one opaque score.

baseline_noninferiority.definition: a non-baseline candidate is materially worse if strategy compatibility is more than 5 percentage points lower or catastrophic rate is more than 2 percentage points higher than deterministic policy on the same VALID_EVIDENCE cases

selection_policy.real_prototype_requires: all gate thresholds pass, candidate is not materially worse than deterministic baseline, and a new untouched real holdout is registered

execution_status: No synthetic benchmark corpus has been executed by this design artifact. Full V4 serving remains unimplemented.
